leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a Node.js server using Express to handle HTTP requests for notifications.
Configure middleware to parse incoming JSON payloads in notification requests.
Implement a POST endpoint to receive and validate notification data.
Initialize and integrate a service module to process and store notification messages.
Manipulate response objects to return appropriate HTTP status codes and messages.
Apply routing structures to organize API endpoints for different notification types.
Control error handling within the API to manage invalid requests gracefully.
